title: fix(objectql): announce NULL count/sum roll-up holes at boot, naming os migrate summary-nulls
body:
Fixes #34283

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：重启后新加入的汇总字段（计数、求和）在旧记录上仍为空时，运维人员在启动日志里会看到一条提示，写明哪些字段有空值以及补齐用的命令；最终用户无感。
2. 为什么做：上一轮“升级后汇总字段自动补算”只覆盖运行中安装的情形，随重启进来的汇总字段在旧记录上一直为空且无人提示，这是它的后续。
3. 出错会怎样：最坏情况是提示漏报或误报一条日志；启动时只读不写、读失败也不会阻止启动，回滚本次改动即可。
4. 要你做什么：无。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- New module `packages/objectql/src/summary-hole-announce.ts`: `announceSummaryHoles` reads the first `ADVISORY_SAMPLE_SIZE` (100) rows of each object owning a `count`/`sum` roll-up (`id` plus the roll-up columns, system context, one read per such object, nothing for an object owning none). A stored `null`/`undefined` in a `count`/`sum` column is a hole (their empty-set value is 0, so a computed column is never NULL). It logs ONE `warn` per boot naming each `object.field (fn, N of the first M rows)` and the two command lines: `os migrate summary-nulls --object OBJECT` (dry run) and `os migrate summary-nulls --apply --object OBJECT`. It writes nothing; an unreadable object is skipped at `debug`; it never fails the boot. A `debug` line reports the sample's cost (objects read, rows read, ms).
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`: the `kernel:bootstrapped` hook calls it right after `announceStoredExpressionHoles` (after `sealSummariesMaterialisedAtBoot`, so the roll-ups it reads are exactly the ones just sealed as computed).
- `min`/`max`/`avg` are not announced: a NULL there is the legitimate reading of "no child rows", and the default `os migrate summary-nulls` run leaves them alone (`summaryNullIsBackfillable`, the backfill's own predicate).
- Not done (ruled out on the card): persisting the computed set (option B).

### Tests

New file `packages/objectql/src/engine-34283-restart-summary-hole-announce.test.ts`, booting a real `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin` over a memory driver that already holds rows stored by the version before (no roll-up column), while an app plugin registers the version with three roll-ups (`sum`, `count`, `max`) before `kernel:bootstrapped`:

- a NULL count/sum is named exactly once, with both summary-nulls lines, the `max` is not named, the boot made zero driver writes, and the sample was one read of the parent capped at 100 (the child object is not read);
- CONTROL: a computed column (values, including 0 and a NULL `max`) announces nothing and writes nothing;
- CONTROL: an unreadable object resolves `[]`, no warn, one `debug` skip line.

Ablations (on-disk via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the test imports `./plugin.js` from source, so no dist leg):

- delete the `announceSummaryHoles` call in `plugin.ts`: case 1 red (`expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`);
- hole predicate `!= null` to truthiness (0 read as a hole): the computed-column CONTROL red;
- drop the `summaryNullIsBackfillable` filter: case 1 red (`not to contain 'largest_invoice'`) and the CONTROL red.

### Acceptance notes

- Boot cost on a showcase boot (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh --log-level debug`, worktree build at this branch, shared box): `[summary-holes] boot sample {"objectsRead":3,"rowsRead":21,"ms":3}`; the whole bootstrap took about 3.9 s (`Bootstrap started` 08:00:49.552Z to `Bootstrap complete` 08:00:53.451Z). No `[summary-holes]` warn on the fresh showcase: its seeded parents hold computed values.
- One warn per boot (the stored-expression precedent's shape), not one per object: every object with a hole is named in the one line and gets its own `--object` flag on the command.

### Verification

See the os-dev report comment on the card for the local gate subset with exit codes; CI carries the rest.
